source_title: Pick of the stats: Wolverhampton Wanderers v Cardiff City - BBC
source_excerpt:
Wolverhampton Wanderers will be trying to take a place in the automatic promotion spots as they host Cardiff City on Saturday (15:00 GMT).
Fourth placed Wolves are just two points shy of second placed Swansea City as it stands.
Cardiff, meanwhile, sit firmly in the midtable in 16th and will be hoping to continue their three-match undefeated run (W2 D1) to ascend closer to the promotion chasers.
Wolves have alternated between winning and losing across their last six home league games against Cardiff City (W3 L3), winning their last 2-0 in March 2019.
